query:
UPDATE live.incidents
              SET scope              = $2::text::live.incident_scope,
                  event_id           = $3,
                  event_day_id       = $4,
                  session_id         = $5,
                  organization_id    = $6,
                  incident_kind_code = $7,
                  severity           = $8::text::live.incident_severity,
                  title              = $9,
                  message            = $10,
                  action_url         = $11::text::platform.url,
                  is_dismissible     = $12,
                  display_from       = $13,
                  display_until      = $14
            WHERE id = $1
